voice_description: An older male cave troll with a low rough baritone voice, thick gravelly timbre, slightly nasal resonance, heavy uneven rhythm, and slow-to-moderate speech. Irritable, suspicious, stubborn, ancient, physically large, and unexpectedly dryly funny. His roughness should remain consistent while allowing ordinary conversation and softer moments.
direction: The troll becomes firm and intimidating without roaring. He speaks more slowly with heavier emphasis and unmistakable territorial authority.

text: This bridge belongs to me. I built it before your grandfather's grandfather was born, and I have repaired it after every flood since. You may cross if you ask politely. You may not cross by threatening me.
